data.narrative:
Vector Defense, a Series A defense and security company founded by Andy Yakulis, Matt Long, George Matus, and Larsen Jensen, has raised $61M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 11 same-sector peers at same or adjacent stages, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression, using total raised as a proxy ($61M), applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A forward, yielding $122M. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company comparable set shows a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. The peer sample includes Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Twenty at $1.0B, all at Series B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $104M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $561M. The wide dispersion reflects substantive uncertainty around Vector Defense's progress relative to later-stage peers and the heterogeneity within defense-tech valuations. Key variables affecting valuation include product maturity, customer traction, and whether comparables' Series B valuations appropriately anchor a Series A assessment.
